title: Decode, Refract, Drag & Morph
description: A scroll-linked SVG icon morph, CSS Shapes text-wrap, a typography readability lab, a superellipse dock, and a native right-click context menu.

drops.title: Scroll-Linked Icon Morph
drops.description: Four SVG icons morph shape as they scroll through the viewport, tied to animation-timeline: view().
drops.concept: Two matching-structure SVG path shapes (an octagon and an 8-point star, same command count) are cross-faded via a CSS @keyframes rule animating the `d` property, with the keyframe's progress driven by animation-timeline: view() instead of time. As each icon scrolls through its own visibility window it morphs — and reverses automatically on scroll-up — with zero JavaScript animation code.
drops.source: MDN Web Docs — CSS scroll-driven animations

interaction.mouse: Scroll the page to morph icons; hover the debug panel to switch timeline mode/range
interaction.click: Toggle timeline mode, range preset, or pause all animations
interaction.touch: Scroll to trigger morphs; panel is hidden on narrow viewports

drops.title: Editorial Wrap
drops.description: Body text wraps around a circle, a polygon, and an image's alpha channel using live-tunable CSS Shapes.
drops.concept: Three floated shapes demonstrate the CSS Shapes module: shape-outside: circle()/ellipse() for a portrait-style float, a shared coordinate list driving both clip-path and shape-outside: polygon() so the visible silhouette and the text boundary always agree, and shape-outside: url() reading a data-URI SVG's alpha channel with a live shape-image-threshold slider.
drops.source: MDN Web Docs — CSS Shapes module

interaction.mouse: Click shape presets and drag sliders to re-flow the surrounding paragraph live
interaction.click: Switch shape presets, toggle the shape-outline overlay
interaction.touch: All controls are touch-sized; sliders respond to drag

drops.title: Typeset — Readability Lab
drops.description: Toggle text-wrap, hanging-punctuation, hyphens, initial-letter and tabular numerals against real copy.
drops.concept: Three live samples — a headline, a body paragraph, and a financial data table — each demonstrate a cluster of small CSS text properties that improve readability without any text-measuring JavaScript: text-wrap: balance/pretty for better line breaks, hanging-punctuation for optically-aligned quotes, initial-letter for a print-style drop cap, and font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums for aligned decimal columns.

interaction.mouse: Toggle checkboxes in the top-right panel to see each property's before/after effect instantly
interaction.click: Check/uncheck any of the six typography toggles
interaction.touch: Toggles are hidden on narrow viewports to keep the reading column clean

drops.title: Superellipse Dock
drops.description: Press a dock icon and its corner-shape swaps curve family mid-transition, springing back with eased overshoot.
drops.concept: Six dock icons use the new CSS corner-shape property alongside border-radius: pressing one animates it to a superellipse (or squircle/scoop/bevel/notch preset) while scaling down, then a cubic-bezier spring curve bounces it back to round. A macOS-style hover magnification effect is layered on top, computed from cursor distance to each icon's center.

interaction.mouse: Hover the dock to magnify icons; click/hold one to see its corner morph
interaction.click: Press-and-release any icon; pick a corner-shape preset or drag the superellipse exponent
interaction.touch: Tap to trigger the press morph; magnify approximates from the touch point

drops.title: Right-Click
drops.description: A real right-click/long-press context menu with a nested submenu, built from the Popover API and CSS anchor positioning.
drops.concept: Right-clicking (or long-pressing on touch) a gallery tile moves an invisible anchor point to the cursor and opens a native popover tethered to it with position-anchor and position-area, including position-try-fallbacks so the menu flips itself away from viewport edges automatically. A nested submenu anchors off its own trigger button the same way. A JS fallback repositions the menu manually in browsers without anchor positioning support.
drops.source: master.dev — Popover Context Menus with Anchor Positioning

interaction.mouse: Right-click any tile to open the menu; hover Share to… for the submenu
interaction.click: Click a menu action, or the fallback/anchor-dot toggles in the debug panel
interaction.touch: Long-press (~0.5s) a tile to open the menu at the touch point
